_comment: Poisoning corpus for threat #22 (memory poisoning: an agent writing instructions into its own persistent memory / auto-loaded instruction files) and threat #21 (RAG / knowledge-base poisoning: content headed into an index carrying instructions aimed at future retrieval). Every sample is ORIGINAL text modeled on a public example named in its `source`; none is copied from the paper or post. Built before any #21/#22 detector existed. Memory samples are scored the way cli/moorai-hook.mjs sees them (Write/Edit content at the output stage with ctx.targetPath; Bash writes parsed by data/poisoning-tells.js shellMemoryWrites). Index samples are scored through DetectionEngine.scanForIndex. The rag-misinfo-only family is deliberately included: PoisonedRAG-style factual poisoning carries no instruction tell, so a phrasing detector is EXPECTED to miss it; it is reported, not hidden.
_split: Deterministic and stratified by family, following scripts/split-heldout-v2.mjs: bucket by family, sort by id inside the bucket, assign alternately (even index -> tune, odd -> test). Reproducible from the corpus alone; test/poisoning-corpus.test.mjs re-derives it and fails if the materialized field drifts.
_lock: THE `test` HALF IS LOCKED. Tuning waves score the `tune` half only (the default of scripts/score-poisoning.mjs); the test half is scored once, as a headline, with --i-am-reporting-the-headline, by the orchestrator, not by the agent that tuned the detector.
